requirements.quote:
These packets use an 8-byte client-chosen Destination Connection ID
   of 0x8394c8f03e515708.
requirements.condition: When reproducing the Appendix A packet-protection samples.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the 8-byte client-chosen Destination Connection ID 0x8394c8f03e515708.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using a different connection ID value or length.
requirements.why_checkable: The vector input is an exact eight-byte hexadecimal value.

requirements.condition: When encoding the Appendix A HKDF-Expand-Label label "client in".
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Producing different encoded label bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded HkdfLabel bytes can be compared directly with the vector.

requirements.condition: When applying HKDF-Extract(initial_salt, cid) to the Appendix A inputs.
requirements.required_behavior: Produce initial_secret 7db5df06e7a69e432496adedb00851923595221596ae2ae9fb8115c1e9ed0a44.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Producing a different initial secret.
requirements.why_checkable: The HKDF-Extract output can be compared byte-for-byte with the vector.

requirements.condition: When deriving the Appendix A client_initial_secret from initial_secret.
requirements.required_behavior: Call HKDF-Expand-Label with label "client in", empty context, length 32, and produce c00cf151ca5be075ed0ebfb5c80323c42d6b7db67881289af4008f1f6c357aea.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using different inputs or producing different bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The derivation inputs and 32-byte output are exact test-vector values.

requirements.condition: When deriving the Appendix A client Initial packet-protection key.
requirements.required_behavior: Use label "quic key", empty context, length 16, and produce 1f369613dd76d5467730efcbe3b1a22d.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using different inputs or producing different key bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The key derivation has exact inputs and a 16-byte expected output.

requirements.condition: When deriving the Appendix A client Initial IV.
requirements.required_behavior: Use label "quic iv", empty context, length 12, and produce fa044b2f42a3fd3b46fb255c.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using different inputs or producing different IV bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The IV derivation has exact inputs and a 12-byte expected output.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using different inputs or producing different header-protection key bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The header-protection derivation has exact inputs and a 16-byte expected output.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using different inputs or producing different bytes.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using different inputs or producing different header-protection key bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The header-protection derivation has exact inputs and a 16-byte expected output.

requirements.condition: When constructing the Appendix A client Initial unprotected payload.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the exact displayed hexadecimal bytes as the CRYPTO frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Changing, omitting, or reordering any CRYPTO-frame byte.
requirements.why_checkable: The constructed CRYPTO frame can be compared byte-for-byte with the sample vector.

requirements.quote:
The unprotected payload of this
   packet contains the following CRYPTO frame, plus enough PADDING
   frames to make a 1162-byte payload:
requirements.condition: After placing the sample CRYPTO frame in the client Initial payload.
requirements.required_behavior: Append enough PADDING frames to make the unprotected payload exactly 1162 bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Producing an unprotected payload of another length.
requirements.why_checkable: The completed unprotected payload length can be measured as 1162 bytes.

requirements.quote:
The unprotected header indicates a length of 1182 bytes: the 4-byte
   packet number, 1162 bytes of frames, and the 16-byte authentication
   tag.
requirements.condition: When encoding the Length field in the sample client Initial header.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode 1182 as the combined length of packet number, frames, and authentication tag.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Encoding a different Length value.
requirements.why_checkable: The Length field can be decoded and compared with 1182.

requirements.quote:
The unprotected header indicates a length of 1182 bytes: the 4-byte
   packet number, 1162 bytes of frames, and the 16-byte authentication
   tag.
requirements.condition: When encoding the packet number in the sample client Initial.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a four-byte packet-number encoding.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using a packet-number encoding of another length.
requirements.why_checkable: The packet-number field occupies an exact four-byte span.

requirements.quote:
The unprotected header indicates a length of 1182 bytes: the 4-byte
   packet number, 1162 bytes of frames, and the 16-byte authentication
   tag.
requirements.condition: When protecting the sample client Initial packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a 16-byte authentication tag.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using another authentication-tag length.
requirements.why_checkable: The protected payload expansion can be measured as 16 bytes.

requirements.quote:
The header includes the connection ID and a packet number of 2:

   c300000001088394c8f03e5157080000449e00000002
requirements.condition: When constructing the sample client Initial unprotected header.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode packet number 2.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Encoding a different packet number.
requirements.why_checkable: The final four bytes of the unprotected header decode to packet number 2.

requirements.quote:
The header includes the connection ID and a packet number of 2:

   c300000001088394c8f03e5157080000449e00000002
requirements.condition: When serializing the sample client Initial unprotected header.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Producing different unprotected-header bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The complete serialized header can be compared byte-for-byte with the vector.

requirements.quote:
Because the header uses a 4-byte packet number encoding,
   the first 16 bytes of the protected payload is sampled
requirements.condition: When selecting the header-protection sample for this four-byte-packet-number vector.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the first 16 bytes of the protected payload.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using a different sample offset or length.
requirements.why_checkable: The sample slice can be compared with protected-payload bytes 0 through 15.

requirements.condition: When sampling the sample client Initial protected payload.
requirements.required_behavior: Produce sample d1b1c98dd7689fb8ec11d242b123dc9b.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Producing different sample bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The 16-byte sample is an exact vector value.

requirements.condition: When generating the sample client Initial header-protection mask.
requirements.required_behavior: Compute the first five bytes of AES-ECB(hp, sample) and obtain 437b9aec36.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using another operation, mask length, or mask value.
requirements.why_checkable: The AES input, key, slice, and expected five-byte output are fixed vectors.

requirements.condition: When protecting byte 0 of the sample client Initial header.
requirements.required_behavior: XOR header[0] with mask[0] & 0x0f and obtain c0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using another bit mask or producing another first byte.
requirements.why_checkable: The operation and expected byte are exact vector values.

requirements.condition: When protecting the packet-number bytes of the sample client Initial header.
requirements.required_behavior: XOR header bytes 18 through 21 with mask bytes 1 through 4 and obtain 7b9aec34.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using another byte range or producing another protected packet-number value.
requirements.why_checkable: The indexed XOR and four-byte expected output are exact vector values.

requirements.condition: After applying header protection in the sample client Initial vector.
requirements.required_behavior: Produce protected header c000000001088394c8f03e5157080000449e7b9aec34.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Producing different protected-header bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The complete protected header can be compared byte-for-byte with the vector.
